body:
Could we rename this variable, by the way? There are two notions of "handled" here -- one whether the `unhandledrejection` event is canceled (e.g., generally with `preventDefault`), which is this one, and whether the promise itself was handled, which is p.[[PromiseIsHandled]] (this might have occurred if the event listener decided to add a handler while running).

At a minimum _eventNotHandled_ might be clearer, but a better name might exist.
